description: This file defines the PlayerInfo class, which implements plugin functionality for a media player system. It includes class definitions, notification mechanisms, and interface implementations relevant to player information and Dolby output notifications within a plugin architecture.

classes.name: PlayerInfo
classes.description: Main class implementing plugin interface, web, and JSON RPC functionalities related to player information and Dolby output.

classes.name: PlayerInfo::Notification
classes.description: Handles remote connection notifications, such as activation and deactivation events.

classes.name: PlayerInfo::DolbyNotification
classes.description: Handles Dolby output notifications, including initialization, deinitialization, and audio mode changes.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles the deactivation of remote connections.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Retrieves and fills in player codecs data.
